# Hyeonse Design System

> @hyeonse/design-system 0.3.0: semantic CSS tokens, React display preferences, and basic form primitives for personal projects.

Use the installed package reference. Button, TextField, Checkbox, and Badge are exported from the primitives module. Card and page-layout React components are not exported.

## Start here

- [AI usage](./docs/ai.md): local CLI, JSON lookups and integration workflow.
- [Setup and API](./docs/api.md): supported imports and first-paint preferences.
- [Foundations](./docs/foundations.md): token roles and visual principles.
- [Full generated reference](./llms-full.txt): exact API signatures, token conditions and examples.

## Machine-readable references

- [Catalog](./dist/catalog.json): API, locally declared props, tokens, states and examples from this package.
- [Catalog schema](./schemas/catalog.schema.json): version 1 format.

## Tools

- [Agent skill](./skills/hyeonse-design-system/SKILL.md): task-specific use of this system.
- [CSS audit](./docs/audit.md): consumer token checks and limitations.

Run the local binary with `npm exec --no -- hds list`, then `npm exec --no -- hds show Button --json`. In this repository, use `npm run hds -- list`. Commands only read the installed package and never fetch or install another package.
